# Petya Andromeda D11: D10 plus the families it still gets wrong, keeping what D10 fixed

D10 is the group's D (46/54 new with 30 exact, 36/42 v22, 797/801 familiar). Its remaining errors are quotes
(invented summaries «Копия анкеты», «Загадочная цитата», additions), cancellations («назначение dock_slot», inverted
renames), codes (the next issue by a new code lost, «по нему же коду») and two recipients («без пояснения» lost).
D11 continues D10 on the familiar cases once, plus the last dialogues 61–80 of those four families and 61–70 of the
four families D10 fixed (open-recipient, permission, screen-only, exact-name) — 921 presentations at lr 5e-7.
`Train Petya.app` runs `execution.json` into `~/.petya-train/andromeda-d11`. Gate: replaces D10 only if not worse
than D10 on any set. These are the last unused dialogues of the D2 families; a further stage needs new data.

## Result: rejected, D10 stays

| Set | D11 | D10 |
|---|---|---|
| 54 generated held-out drafts | 41 (33 exact) | 46 (30 exact) |
| 30 v22 checks + 12 v22 drafts | 28 + 8 | 28 + 8 |
| 801 familiar cases | 798 | 797 |

More exact answers, but five D10 successes lost: two permissions became orders again («Получатель — нотариус»),
«без пояснения» dropped for two recipients, a typo, one code case. The gate rejects it; D10 stays the group's D.
Ten rehearsal dialogues per fixed family were not enough to hold the permission wording.
